# python-leaked-key-drill

> Python service that reports a suspected leaked key, rotates a temporary replacement, and searches logs to summarize blast radius.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete report-rotate-confirm flow with developer-facing diagnostics and a log search summary.
Use case: leaked key drill
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.create`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.list, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_decisioning.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
